notes.title: Redisign update
notes.notes:
Hello there, horror lovers) It's time for a new update. It's not the biggest update, but the most visible, so let's start from the beginning: 

 The main menu music and some sounds have been changed. In our opinion, the music now better suits the tense atmosphere of the game itself;
 The main menu design has been changed, especially the lighting has been changed, and camera effects have been added.
 The level design has been changed. Now things have a more meaningful position in the level, and perhaps this will have a practical application...


Some bugs were also fixed:

 The logic of rebinding keys was completed. This logic... works now:D
 The screen mode now switches without any problems.


That's all for now. There will be more to come, but for now good luck to everyone in surviving the nights)

notes.title: Update January 11
notes.notes:
Greetings to all horror fans! The promised update has arrived, but why hasn't it been around for so long? In fact, we are beginner game developers, so as we gradually create games, we improve our skills, which can delay updates for a long time. In our case, we remade the game for C++, which, in a good way, should have affected performance. However, this is not the point of the update.

The AI of animatronics and entities was completely redesigned, which made the game more difficult to complete. We advise you to try to play through the game again from the very first night.
 Lightening model textures and reducing their polygons for better performance.

Yes, the list itself is quite small, but it assumes a faster release of future updates with more global changes. That's all, good luck surviving the night)

notes.title: patch 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hi there! Some bugs have been fixed in this patch:


 Mangle is now shown when it attacks you and not tries to escape you
 The fire stops when the player looks in the tablet

We also changed the position of buttons in the menu to the left side of the screen in order to make it more logical.
That's all. Good luck surviving nights;)
